description: Ecosystem-wide Pump.fun deployer stats — tracked_count (how many deployers we grade), signals_today, bonds_detected, the chain-wide bond_rate, and a per-tier count (elite/good/rising). Use this to size expectations before reading the leaderboard: a bond_rate of ~0.02 chain-wide is what makes an elite deployer's 0.30 meaningful. Requires an msk_ key.
name: madeonsol_deployer_stats
